title: Neko Den
author: RareSection5520
selftext:
Hey everyone! 🐱🌸

I'm an indie developer working on GHO Neko Den, a cozy, Japanese-inspired virtual pet game, and I'm looking for people willing to playtest it and give me some honest feedback!

The game is already playable, but I'm actively developing, expanding, and polishing it. I'd really appreciate some fresh eyes on the experience.

🐾 What is GHO Neko Den?

It's a relaxing virtual pet game where you can:

\- 🐱 Choose from unique Nekos with different personalities, animations, and behaviors.

\- 🌸 Explore beautiful Japanese-inspired environments with day/night cycles.

\- 🎀 Customize your Nekos with hats, halos, and wings.

\- 🌱 Grow and care for plants in the Garden.

\- 🎮 Enjoy several minigames and interactive activities.

\- 💕 Build bonds with your Nekos and discover special visitors.

🔍 What I'm looking for testers to check:

1. Gameplay: Is it fun, engaging, and easy to understand?

2. Controls: Do buttons, menus, and interactions work properly?

3. Animations: Do the Nekos move, play, and interact naturally?

4. Performance: Any lag, freezing, or excessive loading?

5. Mobile compatibility: Does everything display and function correctly on your phone?

6. Bugs: Anything broken, overlapping, missing, or behaving strangely?

7. Overall experience: What would you improve, remove, or add?

🎮 Play for free:

https://battleatom.itch.io/gho-neko-den

Platforms: Desktop and mobile browsers (HTML5).

Android app: Coming soon.

Cost: Completely free to play right now.

You don't need to install anything or create an account to try it.

I'm developing this independently, and feedback from real players would mean a lot. Whether you play for five minutes or an hour, even a short comment about your experience would be incredibly helpful.

If you encounter a bug, please include your device/browser and a description of what happened. Screenshots are especially helpful!

Thanks for helping make GHO Neko Den better! 🐾🌸

— GHO Labs

A Note About AI and GHO Neko Den 🐾

I want to be transparent about how GHO Neko Den is being created.

Yes, I use artificial intelligence to help develop my game, including programming, artwork, animations, and other aspects of development.

Some of the artwork comes from my own drawings and ideas. Other artwork is AI-generated. I'm not claiming that every image was hand-drawn by me, or that every line of code was written manually.

But here's what I want people to understand:

The creative vision behind GHO Neko Den is mine.

From the characters and their personalities to their movements, behaviors, interactions, environments, mini-games, and tiny details, I'm the one making those creative decisions.

Even when artwork is generated entirely by AI, I'm directing what I want, how it should look, what needs to change, and how it fits into the game.

I spend countless hours developing ideas, reviewing results, finding problems, requesting changes, testing features, and refining the experience until it matches what I envisioned.

AI helps me bring those ideas to life in ways I wouldn't otherwise be able to accomplish on my own.

AI is part of my development process. It isn't the creative vision behind the game.

GHO Neko Den is an independently created passion project, built through a combination of my own artwork, imagination, creative direction, and AI-assisted development.

I'm proud of what I'm creating, and I believe in being open about how it's made.

Thank you for supporting GHO Neko Den. 🐱🌸
